details:
- CVE-2026-63074: roll cached CMP extraCerts back off ctx->untrusted on both
  message-rejection paths, so a client that repeatedly sends rejected messages
  can no longer grow a long-lived OSSL_CMP_CTX without bound
- CVE-2026-63076: require the CMP protectionAlg parameter to be a
  V_ASN1_SEQUENCE before it is used as a PBMParameter, so a crafted parameter
  of another ASN.1 type is no longer dereferenced as a bogus pointer
- CVE-2026-14457: skip the signature_algorithms_cert restriction when RFC 7250
  raw public keys are negotiated and reject a key-only slot when they are not,
  so a peer soliciting raw public keys against a key-only configuration can no
  longer trigger a NULL pointer dereference in check_cert_usable()
- CVE-2026-63075: stop recording ACK-only QUIC packets in the TX history while
  still advancing the history's highest sent packet number, so a peer that
  withholds acknowledgements can no longer drive unbounded memory growth
